title: GetCredentialingWorkflowResponse
description: Response containing a single credentialing workflow

id.description: Unique identifier for the credentialing workflow

data.description: Credentialing workflow data including practitioner information and computed fields

deletedData.description: Soft-deleted records archived from this workflow's sections

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the credentialing workflow

updatedBy.description: ID of the user who updated the credentialing workflow

createdAt.description: Timestamp of the credentialing workflow creation

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the credentialing workflow update

applicationCompleteDate.description: Timestamp when the practitioner's application was marked complete

applicationCompleteSource.description: Source that marked the application complete (one of: WORKFLOW_CREATED, NO_SECTION_B_OUTREACH, LATEST_INFORMATION_RECEIVED_EMAIL, LATEST_INFORMATION_RECEIVED_CAQH, NO_VALID_RESPONSE, CANCELLED_BEFORE_PSV)

anchorGroupId.description: NSCP: the Anchor Group this workflow belongs to. Stamped at creation for every shared-eligible workflow (any credentialing cycle); null = not a shared credentialing workflow. Read-only — set by the platform, never by callers.

sharedCredWorkflowId.description: NSCP: the shared credentialing run this workflow belongs to. Stamped at creation together with anchorGroupId; null = standalone. Read-only.

additionalInfo.description: Where the workflow was created from; omitted when it was created directly

psvSummary.description: PSV transparency values as the workflow's PSV packet shows them (File Type, PSV Progression, PSV Verification). Omitted unless the tenant is switched on for PSV transparency.

CredentialingWorkflowAdditionalInfo.description: Where the credentialing workflow was created from

source.description: System that created the workflow. Only ROSTER is accepted on create; readers must tolerate other values.

sourceId.description: Identifier of the originating record in the source system, stored as sent.

PsvSummary.description: PSV transparency values as the workflow's PSV packet shows them: File Type, PSV Progression and PSV Verification. Present only for a tenant switched on for PSV transparency.

fileType.description: The packet's File Type and the non-clean reasons it prints

psvProgression.description: READY or BLOCKED while the workflow is Not Started, In Progress, Outreach In Progress or Data Missing; null in any other status or before the first evaluation

psvVerification.description: The packet's PSV Verification; omitted when no outcome was recorded

PsvSummaryFileType.description: The packet's File Type and the reasons it prints

value.description: CLEAN, NON_CLEAN or PENDING; null when no File Type applies

frozen.description: True when the verdict is frozen

reasons.description: The non-clean reasons the packet prints; reasons hidden from the packet are left out

PsvSummaryReason.description: One reason or exception the packet prints

outcome.description: VERIFIED_WITH_EXCEPTIONS while at least one exception is printed, else VERIFIED

exceptions.description: The exceptions the packet prints; exceptions hidden from the packet are left out
